**File audited:** `dashboard/static/shadow_walk.html` (1,018 lines, 112,293 bytes). `dashboard/static/games/shadow_walk.html` does not exist — the only other copies are build artifacts (`site/dist/games/shadow_walk.html`, `dist_audit/nacho_business_audit_20260912T214050Z/dashboard/static/shadow_walk.html`), which I did not audit. ## Juice - **RUN OFF — the default mode — has zero audio.** `chime()` (`shadow_walk.html:286-300`) is only called from the run loop: warden correct `:409`, wrong `:421`, death `:468`, forge `:476`. `objectiveTick` (`:214-241`) fires `flash()` only — so anchor reaches (`:221`), doctrine pickups (`:238`), and THE ELEVENTH ROOM opening (`:230`) are silent. A first-time player who never presses R hears nothing, ever. - **Milestone feedback is buried in telemetry.** `flash()` (`:813-814`) only appends to the HUD string at `:965`, and the HUD re-renders at 2 Hz (`:936`). "THE ELEVENTH ROOM OPENS" renders as ~1 line of gold text at the tail of a 4-line stats wall — no center banner, no screen-space event. - **No low-runtime juice.** Fog drain (`:450-453`) is the game's core threat, but feedback is a text bar (`runtimeBar` `:492-495`) that only turns orange under 30 (`:957`). No vignette, pulse, or heartbeat. Death (`:466-473`) gets a chime + panel but no flash/shake/red wipe. - **Wayfinding marks are 1–5 px.** Compass tick draws 3 rows (`:576-581`); doctrine diamonds are a 5-pixel cross (`:531-537`). The single most important navigation device is nearly invisible at 320×200. ## Difficulty - **Core fairness bug: warden judgment is decoupled from the answer text.** `wardenQ` shuffles `order` and sets `correct: order.indexOf(0)` with `opts: order.map(j=>t.a[j])` (`:391-393`), but renders buttons from **`t.a` in original order** (`:396`) — `opts` is computed and never used. Since every template's correct answer is index 0 (`:381-388`), the button that *displays* the right answer is judged correct only when `order.indexOf(0)===0` ≈ **1/3 of the time**; a distractor wins the other 2/3. Wrong answers cost `w.t=12` (`:420`) while the standing-in-fog drain continues at 5/s (`:452`) — so honest players get punished ~twice as often as guessers. Keyboard path (`:738-741`) inherits the same indices. - Fog economy itself is legible: 5/s moving, 2.2/s idle, +10/s on validated (`:451-449`), and `panelOpen` freezes the clock (`:445`) so reading is free. That part is well-tuned. - Objective 1 auto-completes frame 1: `anchors[0]` is `WALK.SPAWN_B` (`:184`) and spawn teleports to `WALK.SPAWN_B` (`:165`), radius 6.25 (`:219`). Harmless, but "OBJECTIVE 1/5" ticks with no input. ## Onboarding - **HUD teaches a wrong key.** Lens moved to **O** (`:743`, keys strip `:26`, help `:981`), but the HUD still prints `off (L)` (`:951`). Pressing L as instructed opens the lore log (`:744`). - No first-run overlay — `:1008-1017` boots straight into `newRun()`; all guidance is behind H. First contact is the jargon wall at `:23` (useful OBJECTIVES span buried mid-sentence) plus a 12-binding key strip at `:26`. - THE RUN — the actual game — is `runMode=false` by default (`:252`); entering it requires H → button (`:1004`) or knowing R. - Pointer lock needs a **double**-click (`e.detail===2`, `:764`), documented only inside the hidden help panel. --- ## ONE highest-value polish patch The warden judgment bug is the top pick: it is the difficulty/fairness defect at the center of the mode the game ships as, it is one line, and `w.pending.opts` already exists — the shuffle was half-wired and simply never reached the render. **File:** `dashboard/static/shadow_walk.html` **Exact insertion point:** line 396, inside `wardenQ` — the middle line of the `helpEl.innerHTML` assignment (between `:395` `

# SPECTRAL MAZE — polish audit

**Files read:** `dashboard/static/spectral_maze.html` (canonical source; the requested path `dashboard/static/games/spectral_maze.html` does not exist — the file lives one level up). Confirmed byte-identical build copy: `site/dist/games/spectral_maze.html` (same SHA-256). No files were created or modified.

## Findings

### Juice — thin outside the solver visualization
- **The win moment is a text swap.** `checkWin()` (spectral_maze.html:715-726) writes one string into `#stats`; `updateHUD` then freezes forever (`if(won)return`, :756). No flash, no pop, no sound, no screen effect — the entire goal payoff of the game is a monospace line competing with `pos 12,7 · build 0.8ms` telemetry.
- **Blocked moves are silent no-ops.** `tryMove()` (:701-714) returns on a wall hit (:712) with zero feedback — the 95ms throttle plus 1-cell grid makes control feel unresponsive when you're hugging walls (which is most of a maze game).
- **Filter cycle has no acknowledgment.** `cycleFilter()` (:809-812) only rewrites button text; the canvas band-dim (:256-258) is instant with no transition.
- Player is a flat white rect (:749-750) — no trail, bob, or motion cue. No audio anywhere.
- Existing juice to build on: the lit-sensor sine pulse (:744) and mirror/guide glow in the composite (:242-249).

### Difficulty curve — flat, and can produce unwinnable boards
- **No curve and no variety:** boot seed is fixed `buildWorld(20260906)` (:824) → every player gets the identical first board; `R`/NEW MAZE (:817, :820) is a pure random re-roll at the same difficulty. Nothing ramps, nothing eases the first session.
- **Winnability is not guaranteed:** `buildWorld` keeps the best of 40 gen attempts by lit-sensor count and breaks at ≥2 (:690-693) — but if no attempt reaches 2, it accepts the best including **`lit=0`**. `placeSensors` marks `lit = amp>=LIT_MIN` once at build (:429) and can also return an empty array (candidates need amp≥0.05 and Manhattan ≥6 from source, :399-403). With all sensors dark or absent, `checkWin` (:717-719) can never fire → dead board.
- Sensor placement is purely "brightest amplitude wins" (:419) with spacing ≥6 (:424) — no distance shaping, so the one lit sensor may be across the map or nowhere.
- With no proximity/minimap hint, effective difficulty is aimless walking, not the optics puzzle.

### Onboarding clarity — instructions buried under physics
- Controls are **mid-sentence in the second jargon paragraph** (:21): a new player hits eikonal least-time flood / Snell-emerges copy (:20) before learning that arrows move. Win condition appears only inside the telemetry HUD line mixed with pos/guides/buildMs/HEAP CAP HIT (:767).
- On boot, `runFalsifierStrip()` (:825) fills `#fals` (:27) with a PASS/FAIL physics test report — the first thing under the canvas reads like CI output, not a tutorial.
- Buttons (:23) exist, but `TAB/E` and `R` are never surfaced except in the wall of text.

## ONE highest-value polish patch

**Patch: a banner system — boot goal/controls card (fades on first move) that re-pops as a gold win celebration + screen flash.** One patch, three insertion points, ~25 lines. Fixes the two widest problems at once: nobody reads the onboarding, and winning feels like nothing.

# Polish audit — `dashboard/static/games/swarm.html` (1730 lines, read-only)

## Findings

### Onboarding (worst area)
- **`swarm.html:1533` — the title actively misinforms:** `"move with A/D, everything else is automatic"` is false. Jump (`W/SPACE`, `:694`), shout (`Z`, `:121`), ult (`Q`, `:1164`), drop-through (`S`, `:699`), talk (`T`, `:1136`), and doors (`1/2`, `:116`) are all manual — and the **core progression verb is invisible**: XP comes mostly from the ground-ride harvest header (`:984-997`), which is taught nowhere. Gems actively *flee* (`:954-958`), so a player who trusts "automatic" chases fish that run away and levels at a crawl.
- Door cadence (gate at `DEPTH_LEN=45`, `:164`/`:1016`) gets one toast at the moment it happens; nothing prepares the player before it.
- Good onboarding that exists: doors screen keys (`:1561-1580`), level-up card keys (`:1593`), death-screen meta shop (`:1550-1556`), touch halves (`:137-152`, though title never mentions touch).

### Juice
- **`killMult` combo (up to 5× XP, `:597-598`) is never drawn anywhere** — invisible mechanic, also an undeclared implicit global.
- **`levelUp()` (`:654-679`) is silent** — only `shake=8` (`:678`); no `beep`. The single most-earned moment in the loop has no audio sting.
- **Enemy projectile hits (`:1175-1176`) have no sound and no shake** — flash only. Contact damage (`:912-914`) likewise silent (continuous drain, so per-tick beep would spam — but there's no low-HP heartbeat/vignette either).
- Solid already: kill particles + gridForce + damage numbers (`:614-629`), beat-pulsed grid/platforms (`:552`, `:719`), SUPERHOT audio slowdown (`:1070`), warp-grid juice (`:532-558`).

### Difficulty
- **Known fix verified present:** `mtn.speed=Math.min(46,26+mtn.t*0.45)` at `:1614` — the rock-wall speed cap from the undodgeable-rock bug is in place.
- Horde scaling: spawn floor `0.07s` reached at diffLevel 7 (`:1092`), hp `1+T/55` unbounded (`:587`), n-per-spawn grows with diffLevel (`:1093`) — steep but readable; door choices (`:172-180`) are the pacing valve.
- **Door mods stack multiplicatively forever** — `descend()` preserves `depthMods` then applies `door.f()` (`:1705-1706`); repeated HIGH ROAD / GLASS FIELD compounds `enemySpd`/`take` with no cap. Long runs get spikes, but this is design, not a bug.
- Contact damage is continuous dps with no iframes (by design, `:914`) — flash feedback is the only tell.

**Highest-value patch = onboarding**, because the title sentence is *wrong* about the core verb, and one toast queue fixes it with zero new render code.
